title: Enable all mechanical layers of the board
summary: Shows how to reach every mechanical layer of a board, including disabled ones, through the layer stack and switch MechLayerEnabled on or off, and why MechanicalLayerIterator alone cannot enable a layer.
phrasings: turn on every mechanical layer of a PCB
list mechanical layers and whether they are enabled
disable all mechanical layers on a board

commands.name: EnableAllMechanicalLayers
commands.description: Enable (or disable) every mechanical layer of the board

commands.name: ListMechanicalLayers
commands.description: List the mechanical layers and whether each is enabled
